# The Networker International
> Country-by-country business networking — find live markets, join markets being built, or register interest where we have not launched yet.

Operated by The Networker Group Limited (Company No. 15252227). Contact: hi@thenetworkeruk.com

## What it is
The Networker International is the global routing layer for The Networker. People choose their country on a world map. Live markets open the local Networker site. Building markets collect group/partner intake. Other markets collect interest to attend or list a networking group later.

## Current markets
- United Kingdom — live: https://www.thenetworkeruk.com
- Ireland — building: https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/ireland
- United States — building: https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/united-states
- Other countries — coming soon (register interest on the world map)
- Some markets are unavailable due to sanctions / compliance restrictions

## Canonical URLs
- Home / world map: https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/
- Ireland: https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/ireland
- United States: https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/united-states
- UK platform: https://www.thenetworkeruk.com
- Sitemap: https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/sitemap.xml
- AI crawler policy: https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/agents.txt

## Who it is for
- Attendees: discover trusted business networking communities in markets that are live or coming soon.
- Groups / organisers: get found when a market launches; in building markets, submit group details now.
- Partners / press: contact hi@thenetworkeruk.com — The Networker International is part of The Networker Group Limited.

## How markets launch
We launch market by market. The UK is live first. Ireland and the United States are building. Interest and intake forms help prioritise the next countries.

## FAQ
- What is The Networker International? The global routing layer for The Networker — choose your country to enter a live site, join a building market, or register interest.
- Is The Networker live in Ireland? Not yet; Ireland is building. Register at https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/ireland
- Is The Networker live in the United States? Not yet; the US is building. Register at https://www.thenetworkerinternational.com/united-states
- How do I list a networking group? On a building-market page, choose “I want to list a group” and send your details.
- Where can I see it working today? The UK is live at https://www.thenetworkeruk.com
